record.oneLiner: A sturdy, beaked ornithopod of the Late Jurassic.
record.description: Camptosaurus was a plant-eating, beaked ornithopod of the Late Jurassic of western North America, a heavier-bodied relative of Iguanodon. It could walk on two legs or four.

notableFacts.text: An early, sturdy relative of Iguanodon.
Could move on two legs or four.
